data.title: Autumn Sale: Soak Up Savings with 35% Off Bundles
data.meta_title: Autumn Sale: Soak Up Savings with 35% Off Bundles
data.content:
Get War Robots: Frontiers bundles for less as part of the Steam Autumn Sale! Until October 6, a 35% discount is applied to all four bundles! Choose the one that suits you best — the Ranchu Bundle, the Tempest Bundle, the Pro Pilot Bundle, or the Storm Leviathan Bundle.

Smite the battlefield using Typhon's thunderous devastation with the Storm Leviathan Bundle, including: 

  • Typhon (War Robot)
  • Synthesis (Wrap)
  • 4x Shocktrains (Weapons)
  • Ghost Turret (Supply Gear)
  • Umbrella (Cycle Gear)
  • "Veil" Silva (Common Pilot)
  • 30-Day Premium Account
  • 30,000 Credits
  • 30,000 Salvage

Expand your arsenal with the Pro Pilot Bundle, which includes:

  • Eloise Donovan (Common Pilot)
  • Trogon Paint
  • "I Heart This" Sticker
  • 7,000 Credits
  • 35,000 Salvage
  • 5-Day Premium Account

Leave destruction in your wake with the Tempest Bundle, including:

  • Typhon (War Robot)
  • "Veil" Silva (Common Pilot)
  • 30-Day Premium Account

Show off your style on the battlefield with the Ranchu Bundle, which includes:

  • Goldfish Paint
  • 5,000 Credits
  • 25,000 Salvage
  • 7-Day Premium Account

Dive into these discounts before October 6!
